reuse.why: Adds one isHoliday matcher and plugs it into all three existing off-day predicates, but leaves three separate 'weekend or holiday' predicates (isOffDay in app.ts, the isOff closure and the getNextDate filter) instead of sharing one.

duplication.why: The new MM-DD matching rule is defined once; the pre-existing weekend-or-holiday combination stays repeated at three sites.

placement.why: isHoliday lives in shared/schedules.ts alongside the other schedule date rules and is imported by the server module.

scope.why: Only the holiday checks, a unit test and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Holiday format changes now happen in one function, though the duplicated off-day predicates remain a minor hazard.
